meta_description: Create, capture, and refund charges with the Stripe API. Learn parameters, responses, and best practices.

meta_description: LangChain is a framework for developing applications powered by language models.

title: Universally unique identifier - Wikipedia
meta_description: A universally unique identifier (UUID) is a 128-bit label used for information in computer systems.
text_content: A UUID is a 128-bit identifier standardized by RFC 4122. It is commonly represented as 32 hex digits displayed in five groups separated by hyphens.
excerpt: Definition and common representation of UUIDs with RFC reference.

title: Notion API overview – Notion Help Center
meta_description: Learn how to use the Notion API to integrate with databases, pages, and users, including authentication and rate limits.
text_content: The Notion API supports reading and updating pages and databases via bearer token auth. Observe rate limits and pagination. Use integrations for scoped access.
excerpt: Notion API basics: auth, pagination, and integration permissions.

title: Auth | Supabase Docs
meta_description: Supabase Auth provides user management and authentication with email, passwordless, OAuth providers, and JWT sessions.
text_content: Supabase Auth supports email/password, magic links, and OAuth providers. Sessions use JWTs. Configure redirect URLs and provider secrets, and use RLS to protect data.
excerpt: Supabase Auth features and configuration notes for providers and sessions.

title: Objects: insert | Cloud Storage JSON API
meta_description: Uploads a new object to a Cloud Storage bucket using the JSON API, including parameters and request bodies.
text_content: Use objects.insert to upload objects to a bucket. Supports multipart and resumable uploads. Include contentType and use ifGenerationMatch for concurrency control.

title: What is a DDoS attack? | Cloudflare
meta_description: A DDoS attack attempts to disrupt a service by overwhelming it with traffic from many sources.
text_content: A DDoS attack floods a target with traffic to degrade availability. Common types include volumetric, protocol, and application-layer attacks. Mitigation uses filtering and rate limiting.
excerpt: Cloudflare explainer on DDoS types and mitigation techniques.

title: What is Observability? | Datadog
meta_description: Observability helps teams understand system behavior using logs, metrics, and traces to troubleshoot and improve reliability.
text_content: Observability uses metrics, logs, and traces to explain system behavior. Good telemetry enables faster incident response, root-cause analysis, and capacity planning across services.
excerpt: Datadog overview of observability pillars and operational benefits.

title: Labels and Selectors | Kubernetes
meta_description: Labels are key/value pairs attached to objects. Selectors help group and filter resources in Kubernetes.
text_content: Labels are used to organize Kubernetes objects. Selectors in services and deployments target sets of pods. Use recommended conventions and avoid high-cardinality values when possible.
excerpt: Kubernetes docs on labels, selectors, and best practices.

title: Security best practices for Amazon S3
meta_description: Guidance for securing Amazon S3 including least privilege, encryption, logging, and public access controls.
text_content: Apply least privilege with IAM, block public access by default, and enable encryption in transit and at rest. Turn on access logging and use object ownership controls for ACLs.
excerpt: AWS S3 security checklist: IAM, block public access, encryption, logging.

meta_description: Best practices for writing prompts, using examples, and improving reliability when working with Claude.

title: Attention Is All You Need
meta_description: We propose the Transformer, a model architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions.
text_content: The Transformer uses self-attention and feed-forward layers for sequence modeling. It achieves strong translation results while enabling parallelization and reduced training cost versus RNNs.
excerpt: arXiv abstract for the Transformer paper introducing self-attention architecture.

title: Robots.txt specifications | Google Search Central
meta_description: Learn how robots.txt controls crawling for a site and how Google interprets rules, including syntax and limitations.
text_content: robots.txt provides crawling directives using allow/disallow rules. It does not prevent indexing if URLs are discovered elsewhere. Use noindex alternatives and proper status codes.
excerpt: Google Search Central intro to robots.txt rules and limitations.

title: 12.1. Introduction to Full Text Search
meta_description: PostgreSQL full text search provides document parsing, dictionaries, and ranking for efficient searching.
text_content: PostgreSQL full text search uses tsvector and tsquery types. It supports stemming, dictionaries, ranking, and indexes like GIN. Use configurations per language for best results.

title: 429 Too Many Requests - HTTP | MDN
meta_description: The HTTP 429 status code indicates the user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time.
text_content: 429 Too Many Requests is returned when a rate limit is exceeded. Responses may include Retry-After. Use backoff and reduce request frequency to recover.
excerpt: MDN reference for HTTP 429, Retry-After, and client backoff behavior.
